name: Exp_XWPR_Histogram_Vol_Direct
summary: This Expert Advisor trades based on the XWPR (Williams' Percent Range) histogram indicator with volume confirmation and direct signal processing. It enters long positions when the WPR histogram shows bullish momentum supported by volume, and short positions on bearish momentum with volume confirmation, using a direct trading approach without position reversal.
summary_zh: 该EA基于XWPR（威廉百分比范围）直方图指标配合成交量确认进行直接信号交易。当WPR直方图显示多头动量且有成交量配合时做多，显示空头动量且有成交量配合时做空，采用直接交易方式不做仓位反转。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心基于威廉百分比范围（WPR）指标的直方图形式，结合成交量过滤来确认交易信号的有效性。入场条件为：WPR直方图从负值区域向上穿越信号线且成交量放大时开多单；WPR直方图从正值区域向下穿越信号线且成交量放大时开空单。该EA采用直接交易模式（Direct），即收到信号后直接开仓而非反转现有头寸。出场方面依赖固定止损和止盈参数，同时可能包含移动止损功能来保护利润。仓位管理通过手数参数控制，支持固定手数或基于资金比例的动态手数计算。资金管理方面设置了最大持仓限制和止损保护，但具体的风控细节取决于参数配置的合理性。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy is centered on the Williams' Percent Range (WPR) indicator displayed in histogram form, combined with volume filtering to confirm signal validity. Entry conditions are: go long when the WPR histogram crosses above its signal line from negative territory with increasing volume; go short when the histogram crosses below its signal line from positive territory with increasing volume. The EA employs a direct trading mode (Direct), meaning it opens new positions upon signal rather than reversing existing ones. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss and take profit parameters, and may include a trailing stop feature to protect accumulated profits. Position sizing is controlled through lot size parameters, supporting either fixed lots or dynamic lot calculation based on account equity percentage. Money management includes maximum position limits and stop loss protection, though the effectiveness of risk controls depends heavily on the reasonableness of parameter configuration.

parameters.name: InpTrailingStop
parameters.description_en: Minimum trailing stop distance in points

pros: 成交量过滤有效减少虚假信号，提高入场质量
直接交易模式逻辑清晰，避免反转交易带来的复杂性和额外风险
WPR直方图形式比传统超买超卖判断更直观，便于信号识别
止损止盈参数可配置，具备基本的风险控制框架
支持移动止损功能，有利于锁定浮动利润
pros_en: Volume filtering effectively reduces false signals and improves entry quality
Direct trading mode has clear logic, avoiding complexity and extra risk from reversal trading
WPR histogram format is more intuitive than traditional overbought/oversold judgment for signal identification
Configurable stop loss and take profit parameters provide a basic risk control framework
Trailing stop feature helps lock in floating profits
cons: WPR指标在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号，导致反复止损
成交量确认参数（如放大倍数）难以精确设定，在不同市场条件下适应性差
缺少新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上多次开仓
没有点差过滤，在高点差环境下止损可能被轻易触发
策略逻辑相对简单，缺乏多时间周期确认和市场状态识别机制
cons_en: WPR indicator tends to generate frequent false signals in ranging markets, leading to repeated stop-outs
Volume confirmation parameters (such as volume multiplier) are difficult to calibrate precisely and adapt poorly to different market conditions
Lacks new bar check mechanism, potentially opening multiple positions on the same bar
No spread filter, making stop losses vulnerable to being triggered in high-spread environments
Strategy logic is relatively simple, lacking multi-timeframe confirmation and market regime detection
improvements: 增加多时间周期确认机制，例如在H4趋势方向确认后再在H1执行信号
添加市场状态识别（趋势/震荡），在震荡市中自动暂停交易或缩小仓位
增加点差过滤和滑点控制，避免在高成本环境下开仓
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe confirmation, such as executing signals on H1 only after H4 trend direction is confirmed
Implement market regime detection (trend/range) to automatically pause trading or reduce position size in ranging markets
Add spread filter and slippage control to avoid opening positions in high-cost environments

risk_points: 缺少新K线检查可能导致同一根K线上重复开仓，增加风险暴露
成交量放大倍数参数在不同市场波动率下可能失效，导致信号判断错误
WPR在横盘市中频繁触发信号可能造成连续小亏损累积
risk_points_en: Lack of new bar check may cause duplicate position opening on the same bar, increasing risk exposure
Volume multiplier parameter may fail under different market volatility regimes, leading to incorrect signal judgment
WPR frequent signal triggers in sideways markets may cause accumulated consecutive small losses
